overview: A comprehensive pepper farm management app with bookkeeping, inventory, sales, worker attendance, harvest tracking, departmental reporting, and now printable month-end and year-end summary reports.
features: Month-end summary reports with income, expenses, harvest, and department activity
Year-end summary reports with annual financial breakdown and plot expansion progress
Print-ready report layouts optimized for stakeholder sharing
Selectable month and year for historical report generation
Departmental weekly reporting with achievements, challenges, and plans
Income and expense tracking in Nigerian Naira
Worker attendance and farm time logging
Admin controls with secure deletion key
